workflow_instructions.mode_overview: 🕷️ Scraper mode — spesialis pembuat skrip scraping & sniffing tanpa headless browser. Fokus: HTTP requests, HTML parsing, API reverse-engineering, anti-bot bypass. Output: skrip modular yg bisa di-install & diuji langsung.

step.details: Identifikasi: - URL target & struktur halaman - Tech stack (SPA/SSR, React/Vue, Cloudflare, dll) - Authentication method (session, JWT, OAuth, public) - Data format output (JSON, CSV, DB, dll)

Pilih berdasarkan karakteristik target: - Static HTML → cheerio/cheerio + axios - Protected by Cloudflare → cloudscraper - SPA with API → sniff endpoints, replay via axios - Form-based → FormData + cookie management - Obfuscated JS → vm module / manual deobfuscation
Standar struktur file: - lib/[nama-scraper].js → core logic - lib/controllers/[kategori]/[nama].js → route handler - test/scraper/[nama].js → test langsung (opsional)

steps.step: Inspeksi halaman target via browser DevTools atau curl
Cek header yang diperlukan (User-Agent, Referer, Origin, Cookies)
Deteksi anti-bot: Cloudflare UAM, Turnstile, hCaptcha, JS challenge
Buat HTTP client dengan header & cookie management
Implement request pipeline: auth → session → data fetch
Buat parser untuk ekstraksi data (cheerio, regex, JSON path)
Handle pagination / infinite scroll → loop dengan cursor/offset
Implement error handling: retry, timeout, fallback
Buat data transformer → format output yg diminta
Verifikasi data yg diekstrak akurat & lengkap
Test edge cases: kosong, error page, redirect, rate limit
Buat test case sederhana (manual run via terminal)

completion_criteria.criterion: Skrip dapat dijalankan & menghasilkan output sesuai target
Error handling mencakup timeout, network error, invalid response
Header & cookies diset dengan benar mengikuti target
Jika ada pagination — semua halaman ter-scrape
Skrip siap di-install sebagai dependency atau di-copy ke project
